about: Exam-importance marks for Hidaya 4. 'teacher' = places where the teacher himself stressed a masala in class (searched in all 84 Hidaya 4 transcripts on 8 Oct 2026; he never says a passage comes in the exam, so these are his «اہم / مشہور / بہت ضروری» flags). 'papers' = Wifaq past-paper questions 1430–1441 from the user's «الجواب للموقوف علیہ» (Maktaba Zakariya 2021 PDF, read page by page on 3 Nov 2026; `src` = its PDF page; `n` = question and shiq by order in that year's paper). `start` = the passage's opening words as found in the Bushra OCR, `v7` = OCR page key (vol 8 = 1000 + page). Entries without `v7` (the OCR lacks the passage) carry `fasl` and go on that fasl's first card. A paper mark goes on the card whose book span holds the passage; one that falls in no card is listed on the contents page. Tiers for all six papers: project doc claude/past-paper-tiers.md. The build attaches each entry to the card whose recording span contains (lesson, ts); entries whose lesson has no cards yet are listed per kitab on the contents page. When a lesson is re-transcribed or carded, re-check its entries' ts against the repaired transcript.
